title.narrative: ProSilience ¿ Enhancing soils and agroecology for resilient agri-food systems in Sub-Saharan Africa

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is ¿to contribute to climate-relevant, productive and sus-tainable transformation of agriculture and food systems in low and middle-income countries.¿ The specific objective is: The agroecological transition towards sustainable agri-food sys-tems in selected partner countries is enhanced. The Action comprises three outputs: (1) The adoption of technical and socio-economic measures related to innovation in agroecol-ogy is enhanced in selected partner countries (2) The political and research framework for agroecological transition in selected partner countries is improved. (3) National stakeholders make use of the co-created knowledge and evidence on agroecolo-gy shared at national and international level.
